title: Globex — Renewal Status (Q3 2026)
body: Globex's contract renews 2026-09-30. Status: on track, verbally committed to renew at current seat count with a discussion in progress about adding 300 seats for the newly onboarded business unit. Open items: legal is finalizing an updated data processing addendum requested by Globex's security team; procurement wants a multi-year discount quote. Owner: Sam Reyes. Risk level: low — no competitive evaluation in progress as of this update.
